findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler` has abstract members for `counter_names`, deduplication, group-key extraction, and occurrence construction. This `pass` subclass implements none of them, so it remains abstract. When a detector with this registered group type is processed, `Detector.detector_handler` attempts to instantiate it and raises `TypeError` instead of returning a handler.

findings.title: Evaluation docstring still describes a list return value
findings.body: `evaluate` now returns a dictionary keyed by group key, but this docstring says it returns a list. This misdocuments the changed contract for subclasses and callers; update it to describe the dictionary return value.
